## What

Each step tab on Te doen carried two lines that said nearly the same thing: "0 van de 60 belangrijkste" and "0 van 1242 in totaal". The second done count rarely differs from the first, so it was mostly repetition.

- A tab now reads in one line: "0 van 60 gedaan, uit 1242".
- On the start page the line under each bar says what the bar is out of: "De 60 belangrijkste uit 1242 relaties", next to the "0 van 60" it already showed.
